company: Beijing Moonshot AI Technology Co., Ltd. (月之暗面, "Moonshot AI"; product: Kimi)

ownership.quote: Moonshot AI (Moonshot; ... ) is an artificial intelligence (AI) company based in Beijing, China. ... Major investors include Alibaba Group and Tencent.

stage.quote: Moonshot AI ... has raised about $2 billion at a valuation of $20 billion ... Moonshot was valued at $4.3 billion at the end of 2025 ... and by early 2026, that figure had more than doubled to $10 billion following a $700 million raise.
stage.note: Late-stage private company with successive large rounds since its 2023 seed (~$60M at $300M valuation); last priced round closed 30 Jul 2026 at a $35B valuation per Bloomberg. No formal series letters are used by the company; mapped to the closest stage per instructions.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of reported rounds per Wikipedia/TechCrunch/Bloomberg: ~$60M initial (2023) + $1B led by Alibaba (Feb 2024) + $300M w/ Tencent & Gaorong (Aug 2024) + ~$600M led by IDG Capital (Oct 2025, reported) + ~$700M (early 2026, valuation to $10B) + $2B led by Meituan's Long-Z Investments (May 2026, to $20B valuation, later extended to a $35B valuation close in Jul 2026). Huafeng Capital cited ~$3.9B raised in the 6 months before May 2026 alone, so figures are approximate/overlapping, not all independently confirmed.
total_funding_usd.quote: The company raised $3.9 billion over the past six months, according to Huafeng Capital.

last_round.quote: Moonshot AI ... has raised about $2 billion at a valuation of $20 billion ... The round was led by Chinese food delivery company Meituan's VC arm, Long-Z Investments ... Also participating were Tsinghua Capital, China Mobile, and CPE Yuanfeng.
last_round.note: Bloomberg reported this round (or a subsequent close) pushed Moonshot's valuation to $35 billion by 30 July 2026 ('Moonshot AI Surpasses/Passes Funding Goal to Hit $35 Billion Value'); the incremental new capital raised between the $20B and $35B marks was not separately disclosed in sources reviewed.

revenue.basis: TechCrunch citing Moonshot's financial advisor (Huafeng Capital); matches Wikipedia infobox figure.
revenue.quote: Moonshot's annual recurring revenue topped $200 million in April, driven by rapid growth in paid subscriptions and API usage, per the financial advisor's post.

note: Moonshot AI is the Beijing-based developer of the Kimi chatbot/model family and the 'Hosted Agents' cloud-sandbox product this card is about; the sandbox product itself is a minor line of business (beta, sales-gated, China-only) inside a large, well-funded foundation-model company, so funding/revenue figures here describe the whole company, not the sandbox product specifically. Company reached a ~$35B valuation by Jul 2026 (2nd most valuable private AI company in China after DeepSeek) and was reportedly considering a Hong Kong IPO (Mar 2026); no IPO had completed as of this check. Anthropic has publicly accused Moonshot of distilling/routing requests to Claude (Feb and Sep 2026), triggering a Cyberspace Administration of China investigation — a reputational flag for buyers.
